exact_docstrings.module:
Fixed-profile Experiment 006 facade over the shared run authority.

The capability type, process-local registry, issuance latch, and verification
engine live only in :mod:`falsewake.experiment_002_run_authority`.  This module
does not accept a profile, path, digest, or namespace from its callers.  Every
route below binds the retained capability to profile ``006`` before delegating.
exact_docstrings.reverify_verified_run_registration: Reverify an exact profile-006 capability from its retained state.
exact_docstrings.verify_and_issue_experiment_006_run_regi: Verify the fixed registration and mint the one profile-006 capability.
exact_docstrings.verify_verified_run_registration: Fully verify an exact profile-006 capability.

exact_docstrings._create_sealed_experiment_006_child_bund: Return the fixed Experiment 006 sealed source-bundle descriptor.
exact_docstrings._reverify_experiment_006_run_registratio: Reverify a capability only if its retained profile is Experiment 006.
exact_docstrings._verify_and_issue_experiment_006_run_reg: Verify and issue the fixed Experiment 006 parent capability.
exact_docstrings._verify_and_issue_experiment_006_sealed_: Verify fixed Experiment 006 sealed-child state and mint its capability.
exact_docstrings._verify_experiment_006_run_registration: Reverify only a retained Experiment 006 capability.
